data.name: All That Remains
data.detailed_description:
All That Remains is a 90s inspired eerily atmospheric adventure narrative that lets you experience one man’s life as he comes to terms with his final moments on an abandoned Earth. When is it too late to make the right choices?

When our planet has been damaged beyond repair and society has moved on those that stay behind must come to terms with their decisions while suffering a poisonous smog and the aggressive privatization of a world left behind in this post-apocalyptic alternate history.

  • An engaging interactive narrative/walking simulator.
  • A deep and original narrative told through the world and your memories.
  • Stealth and exploration elements seamlessly blended into experiential game play.
  • Original score featuring 6 unique tracks.
  • Short and sweet (40-60 minute play time).

reviews.review: This game is bad.  And I have played a ton of bad games.  I wouldn't even recommend All That Remains if it were free.  Can't believe they are charging 4 bucks for this.[h1] PROS [/h1]+  ok....so I have sat here for 5 minutes and tried to think of something positive to say.  If there is something positive then its eluding me right now.[h1] CONS [/h1]-  movement.  Ever tried to grind warm meat in a meat grinder?  That's what movement in this game feels like. Its a horrible sludge of getting nowhere.-  graphics.  Everything is fogged over and has that pixellated flashlight ring thing going on.  The store page screenshots are not representative of what I saw on an RTX 2080ti with all the settings maxed out.  DON'T TRUST THOSE SCREENSHOTS.  Also the colour ones they took are the only decent shots in the whole game.  I know because I took exactly the same ones.-  soldiers.  There is no explanation why there are soldiers here.  I mean I can guess why but we are never told why they are gunning down civilians.  They move like Resident Evil 1 zombies but somehow come off as more lifeless.-  story.  Did Elysian Games miss the memo about walking sims?  Story is kinda key here.  You'd think with the military patrolling city streets and shooting people on sight would mean some kind of zombie pandemic apocalypse thingy.  But when we crawl to the end of this threadbare game we see that actually corporations have been polluting the air and making the city uninhabitable.  I suppose residents that couldn't afford to leave or had nowhere else to go are just fair game now for target practice?-  characters.  Another memo missed perhaps that games should have protagonists that we get a feel for and can empathise with.  John, our guy that we put one slow foot in front of the other for, for 30 minutes is an absolutely vacuous human being who we don't get enough information to know about to understand why he was such a twat.  -  stealth mode.  Are....You....Kidding?  You need to stealth your way past soldiers in this game to continue.  With controls as bad as this, it makes stealthing laughable.  What were you thinking Elysian Games?  -  voicing.  Phoned in voice acting is the cherry on top of this diarrhea cake.  Wow.  This is the one excuse where I will take the time to write a review for a bad game.  Usually I just uninstall and move on to more positive experiences but this game needs one.  It is an extortionate amount for the quality and playtime.  It is a complete waste of which doesn't even drop any cards or give you any cheevos.  It is barefaced lying about the screenshots on its storepage having touched them up in photoshop or something like that.Ugh....stay away folks.  I wouldn't even play this with someone else's hard drive.
